glosses: A low neckline on a woman's dress, especially one that reveals or emphasizes her cleavage.

examples.text: I visualized businessmen trying to see the tops of her stockings or into the valley of her décolletage as she bent to put drinks on a table.
examples.ref: 2011, Stephen King, 11/22/63, New York: Scribner, →ISBN, page 450:

examples.text: If you want to continue wearing low-cut necklines and avoid having to rely on turtlenecks and scarves to hide your neck, you have to take care of the delicate skin below your jawline, namely your neck and décolletage.
examples.ref: 2014, Harold Lancer, Younger: The Breakthrough Anti-Aging Method for Radiant Skin:

senseid: en:portion of body revealed by low neckline
glosses: The portion of a woman's body that is revealed by a low neckline; the upper chest, as well, sometimes, as the neck, and shoulders.
